gnosh mcp add

  Add a server: a name, then the command that starts it, or its URL. Put --
  before the server's command when the command has flags of its own:
  gnosh mcp add files -- npx server --port 8080

  Not built yet in this build of gnosh: typing it stops with a message that
  says so.

Usage
  gnosh mcp add [flags] <name> <command-or-url> [arguments...]

Flags
  -s, --scope <scope>
      Where the server is recorded: local (this project, on this machine; the
      default), user or project. (Not built yet.)
  -t, --transport <transport>
      How the server is reached: stdio (a command gnosh starts; the default),
      sse or http. (Not built yet.)
  -e, --env <KEY=value...>
      Environment variables for the server's command. (Not built yet.)
  -H, --header <headers...>
      Headers to send to a remote server, each written "Name: value". (Not
      built yet.)
  --cwd <dir>
      Work in this folder instead of the current one.
  -h, --help
      Show help: gnosh's, or after a command's name that command's.
